name: Emuria! ~Ore ga Do M ni Natta no wa Dou Kangaete mo Omaera ga Warui~
original_name: えむリア！～俺がドＭになったのはどう考えてもお前らが悪い～
source:
This is the first title by Carol Works. Shinji has a fetish for being treated coldly and violently by women. Because of his masochism, he hasn’t been able to get a girlfriend at all. However, a new transfer student Nozomi came into Shinji’s gloomy days, and he fell in love with her at first sight.

But even if he was to confess, she would most likely hate him if she finds out about his peculiar tendency. He sought help from his older sister Fumino, imouto Yasuna, and osananajimi Haruka to overcome it and become a normal guy. However, they flat out refused him; After all, they were the ones who turned him like this in the first place!

Fumino had a drastic suggestion: if they all treated him violently, it may improve his situation. All three of the them were quickly on board with the idea. And so begins Shinji’s abnormal daily life…

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/11/26/november-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是Carol Works的第一部作品。真嗣有一种被女性冷酷暴力对待的癖好。由于他的受虐狂，他根本找不到女朋友。然而，新来的转学生希美走进了真嗣的灰暗日子，他对她一见钟情。

但就算他坦白了，如果她发现了他的特殊倾向，恐怕也会恨他。他向姐姐文野、妹妹安奈和奥那那吉米遥寻求帮助，以克服困难，成为一个正常人。然而，他们断然拒绝了他；毕竟，当初就是他们让他变成这样的！

文野提出了一个激烈的建议：如果他们都暴力对待他，也许会改善他的处境。他们三个人很快就同意了这个想法。真嗣不正常的日常生活就这样开始了……

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/11/26/november-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
